This monitor is completely crap, don't fall for the price, there's a reason behind it.I purchased this 5 months back, now it has a black screen and I am taking rounds with customer service to get it fixed, pray for me now.Coming to the quality of it, the display is of very low quality,  if you are reading something on it the moment you scroll the page the words get blurry, not sure why this kind of monitors getting quality verified by Samsung,  usually I am a big fan of Samsung, I have fold 5, freeze, microwave all from them but this one was a big downside from them.
